reporting.objective: Maximize tuning A1.25, then minimize mean returned-distance ratio; at least 90% tuning coverage.
reporting.cascade: Increasing delta only; return the first collision in the first successful stage, without candidate verification.
reporting.storage: 512 MB maximum across all stages, including their separate order arrays and shifts.
reporting.splits: Unchanged audited database, 500 tuning and 1000 held-out queries per seed; freeze uniform and cascade before either test.
reporting.publication: Exploratory follow-up only; do not change the paper or replace historical results.
